notes: NEW: Apps + storage - Uninstaller and Disk space map are now one tool with four tabs: installed, updates, space and new PC
Update every app in one key, with a progress bar and a plain reason when one can't update (open apps: C closes it and tries again)
New PC: save your app list, then install them all on a new PC in one go (or pick from popular apps)
Uninstall Microsoft Store apps too - and in the space tab, a big folder tells you which app it belongs to
Free edition: see which of your apps have updates
Startup audit: how long your PC takes to start and how much each startup app slows it (M measures your next startup) - and B restarts straight into your BIOS
Screen Director: fixed screens not coming back after switching off two at once, and the headset/speakers hotkey
Cleaner key hints at the bottom of every tool, and the Discord button is easier to find
